Clashes and Looting Reported in Milan Amid Cost-of-Living Protests

Police in Milan deployed tear gas and water cannons following clashes and looting during a second day of protests over living costs and public services.

By LokkeeVerse · 1 min read

Police in Milan utilized tear gas and water cannons on Sunday during a second day of public unrest. According to reports, demonstrators threw stones and looted shops during demonstrations driven by dissatisfaction with rising living costs and poor public services. Reports also noted that bins were set on fire as the unrest unfolded in the city.
